text.p: Quorum Growth Inc said on Friday its shareholders approved a proposal to privatize the company.

"Receiving the overwhelming shareholder approvals will allow us to proceed with the achievement of our privatization onjectives and provide all shareholders with liquidity at significant premium to market value," said Wanda Dorosz, president and chief executive officer of Quorum Growth Inc. "We extend our sincere thanks to our shareholders for their loyalty and support."

The company said it expects to hold a formal meeting of common share purchase warrantholders on May 20 at Quorum's offices in order to get approval for amendments to the purchase warrant indenture to allow holders to participate in the privatisation transaction.
Quorum said it expects the privatization to be completed on or before May 23, 1997.
